katerina sea apartments

The Best Place On Vacation

Book Now!

Katerina Sea Apartments is located in Agioi Apostoloi area , one of the most enchanting location of Chania.
The area is known for its three coves with picturesque beaches, as well as for the beautiful natural park with pines and eucalyptus.
The property is just 120m. from the famous beach,4 km from the Old Venetian Port and the Archaeological Museum of Chania, 15 km from Chania International Airport, 48 km from the city of Rethymnon, while Elafonissi is at 47 km. At a distance of 100m. there is a bus stop.
Close to the property there are many restaurants, supermarkets and tourist shops.
The fully equipped rooms have a kitchenette with oven, fridge, electric hobs, coffee maker and kettle.
They also have a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Bed linen is also provided and a welcome pack is available on arrival .
Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property .
Free private parking is available and a fully equipped barbeque area .
